summary: End-to-end frontend testing of 4 features (Admin Messages filters+status+remove/restore, language-prefixed URLs, checkout promo APPLY button, VIP Gold table repricing 4-14 guests). All flows pass. Mobile filter bar responsive at 390px. No critical bugs found.

issues: <html> lang attribute stays 'en' on /vi/* pages — cosmetic/a11y, ticket tier copy 'STANDARD TICKET / Access to all 3 stages' appears in English on /vi/tickets (likely because tier titles/perks are data-driven, not translated). Not blocking; verify if intentional.

action_items: Optional: verify whether tier titles/perk copy on /vi/tickets should be localized (currently in English)
Optional: set document.documentElement.lang per URL prefix for a11y/SEO
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.js MessagesTab file (~700+ lines) — consider extracting filter bar + card into subcomponents
Sort option values use 'guests-asc'/'guests-desc' (dashes) — good, consistent with data-testid style
seed_data_creation: Reused existing 'TEST RESERVE 61859C' record; changed its status to contacted, removed then restored — final state contacted+active
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verification done: (1) Admin Messages: all 7 filter testids present, floor/status/guests-range/search filters work individually and combine, sort guests-asc/guests-desc reorder correctly (verified UI values), status change from new->contacted saves & persists across reload, remove hides from active list, Removed filter shows Restore, Restore preserves status. Mobile at 390px filters wrap cleanly, no horizontal overflow. (2) Language URLs: /vi renders, navbar Tickets link -> /vi/tickets, refresh persists, /faq (with saved vi) redirects to /vi/faq, /en works, /admin NOT redirected, invalid /xx/tickets falls back to /tickets. (3) Promo APPLY: MZYPL5BKOD applies 95% off, 1 qty 499->25 Kč, 2 qty ->50 Kč, invalid code shows no applied note, editing code clears applied state, Enter key triggers apply. promo-applied-note testid present. (4) Gold card: 'gold-price' shows exact '3999 Kč table fee + 899 Kč per person', 'Only 2 tables available' badge, 'Table close to the stage' perk, no '6 guests included' / '+3 000' copy. Gold checkout: 11 options 4..14 with totals 7 595 / 9 393 / 16 585 Kč for 4/6/14, pay button matches, no promo field in Gold checkout.
